mapper.select: SELECT t1.lms_user_id, t1.user_id, t2.user_name, t2.kana, t2.subsidy_category_id, t1.role, t2.login_id, t1.hope_via_traning, t1.programming_experience, t4.company_name, t6.course_id, t6.course_name, t8.place_name, t8.place_note, t8.place_description FROM m_lms_user t1 INNER JOIN m_user t2 ON t1.user_id = t2.user_id LEFT OUTER JOIN t_user_company t3 ON t1.lms_user_id = t3.lms_user_id LEFT OUTER JOIN m_company t4 ON t3.company_id = t4.company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN t_course_user t5 ON t1.lms_user_id = t5.lms_user_id LEFT OUTER JOIN m_course t6 ON t5.course_id = t6.course_id LEFT OUTER JOIN t_user_place t7 ON t1.lms_user_id = t7.lms_user_id LEFT OUTER JOIN m_place t8 ON t7.place_id = t8.place_id WHERE t1.lms_user_id = #{lmsUserId} AND t1.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg}

SELECT t1.lms_user_id, t2.user_id, t2.user_name, t4.company_name, t6.course_id, t6.course_name, t8.place_name AS placeName
FROM m_lms_user t1
INNER JOIN m_user t2 ON t1.user_id = t2.user_id
INNER JOIN t_user_company t3 ON t1.lms_user_id = t3.lms_user_id AND t3.delete_flg = 0
INNER JOIN m_company t4 ON t3.company_id = t4.company_id AND t4.delete_flg = 0
INNER JOIN t_course_user t5 ON t1.lms_user_id = t5.lms_user_id AND t5.delete_flg = 0
INNER JOIN m_course t6 ON t5.course_id = t6.course_id AND t6.delete_flg = 0
LEFT JOIN t_user_place t7 ON t1.lms_user_id = t7.lms_user_id AND t7.delete_flg = 0
LEFT JOIN m_place t8 ON t7.place_id = t8.place_id AND t8.delete_flg = 0
WHERE t1.delete_flg = 0 AND t3.company_id = #{companyId}
AND t2.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_student_attendance sa WHERE sa.lms_user_id = t1.lms_user_id AND sa.delete_flg = 0 AND sa.training_date >= #{limitDate} )
ORDER BY t2.user_name
